hook: John Schulman is a co-founder and the chief scientist of Thinking Machines Lab, the company led by Mira Murati. He was a co-founder of OpenAI, where he led the creation of ChatGPT and co-led the post-training team from 2022 to 2024, and he is the lead author of the reinforcement learning methods Proximal Policy Optimization and Trust Region Policy Optimization. Between OpenAI and Thinking Machines he did alignment research at Anthropic.

quick_facts: Co-founder and chief scientist at Thinking Machines, according to his own site, joschu.net (read 2026-10-22)
Co-founded OpenAI, where he led the creation of ChatGPT and, from 2022 to 2024, co-led the post-training team that developed models for ChatGPT and the OpenAI API
Worked on the Alignment Science team at Anthropic, which Wikipedia dates from August 2024 to February 2025
Lead author of Trust Region Policy Optimization (ICML 2015) and Proximal Policy Optimization (2017)
PhD in computer science from UC Berkeley, advised by Pieter Abbeel, working on robotics and reinforcement learning, after studying physics at Caltech

achievements.impact: Introduced TRPO with Sergey Levine, Philipp Moritz, Michael Jordan and Pieter Abbeel at ICML 2015.

achievements.title: ChatGPT and OpenAI post-training
achievements.impact: Led the creation of ChatGPT and co-led OpenAI's post-training team from 2022 to 2024, by his own account.
